% Caption kept here, deliberately not typeset - the figure carries a
% number only.  To restore it, move the line below into \caption{}.
% Densities of winning probabilities before the rise in evaluation noise. Regular applicants occupy $[c/v^R,OC/v^R]$ and top applicants $[OC/v^T,W_T^{-1}(1|\sigma_1,OC)]$; the two overlap on $[OC/v^T,OC/v^R]$ because the marginal top applicant, indifferent between the programs, wins with probability $OC/v^T$ in one and $OC/v^R$ in the other. The payline $\lambda^T$ is the mean of the top density. $F$ standard logistic, $G=\mathrm{Beta}(4,4)$ on $[0,1]$; $v^T=1$, $v^R=0.8$, $c=0.12$, $OC=0.3$, $\lambda^T=0.45$, $\sigma=0.18$.
\caption{}
\label{fig:density_before}
\end{figure}
